item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar's stacked with the right inputs — meditation, perspective work, checking whether the moment fits the life you're building. None of that matters if it stays theoretical. Pick the one prompt that's hardest to actually live today, not the easiest, and test it once when it counts. Action: catch yourself mind-reading once, and correct it out loud.
